title: Publish MessageEnvelope-derived BusEventEnvelope records with trust labels
verify: Bus publication uses MessageEnvelope refs and consumable structured fields, not UI projection text.
Trust labels reserve trusted for backend-owned policy, approval/decision, or approved governance-summary facts.
evidence_required: BusEventEnvelope contract tests for scope, allowed AgentProfile visibility, source refs, trace refs, trust labels, and redaction.
constraints: Publisher is backend/harness adapter, never direct model response.
Raw model output, hidden reasoning, UI Feed content, admin notices, raw chat, unapproved proposals, provider memory, and secrets are forbidden Bus content.
invariants: Timeline events may be referenced but cannot publish authoritative state by replay.
Duplicate publication attempts are rejected or idempotently ignored by message/event refs.
verification_targets: Bus publication trust-label mapping and forbidden-content rejection.
